ops.title: Metal deploy gotchas found renaming the cliproxy secret — virtiofs staleness on in-place bundle updates, debloat not surviving reboot, hermes build OOM
ops.body:
Found 2026-07-05 renaming `aperture/static-key` → `cliproxy/api-key` and redeploying (commits 95eb879, b11e8d2).

**In-place metal secret update is NOT seen by the guest without a reboot.** metal reads its sops bundle live from the `metalsecrets` virtiofs share (`--dir=metalsecrets:$STATE_DIR/hosts/metal:ro`, setup.sh). Overwriting `~/.yclaw/state/hosts/metal/secrets.sops.yaml` with `install`/`mv` (rename = NEW inode) does NOT propagate: metal's read-only virtiofs cache pins the OLD inode (stale for hours). So `just redeploy metal` after a secret change silently deploys against the STALE bundle → `sops-install-secrets` fails (`the key 'cliproxy' cannot be found`) → the cliproxy wrapper hangs in its `secrets=[…]` preamble → cliproxy never binds :8317 (launchd shows the wrapper "running" but nothing listens). Confirm via the plaintext key names (sops leaves keys unencrypted): `grep -oE '^(cliproxy|aperture):' "/Volumes/My Shared Files/metalsecrets/secrets.sops.yaml"`. FIX that worked: **reboot metal** (`shutdown -r now` SYNCHRONOUSLY; a backgrounded `nohup … shutdown &` over `tailscale ssh` gets killed on session teardown and never reboots). Better long-term: write the bundle IN PLACE (truncate+rewrite same inode); `redeploy_metal` doesn't handle secret-share staleness. The key VALUE was unchanged here so the bearer never actually broke (cliproxy checks the value, not the sops key name / env var name).

**Debloat does not survive reboot unless re-applied at boot.** `launchctl disable` writes `/var/db/com.apple.xpc.launchd/disabled.plist`, but that db RESETS to the deploy-time baseline on reboot, and `postActivation` runs only on `darwin-rebuild` — so the manifest debloat evaporated on reboot (validate §8's pre-existing "override missing" FAILs). Fixed by factoring the disable loops into `debloatDisableScript` run from BOTH postActivation AND `bootSetupScript` (metal-boot-setup, RunAtLoad every boot). Also: per-user agents must use the `user/<uid>` domain, NOT `gui/<uid>` — headless metal has no Aqua session so `gui/` errors `125`. See [[metal-reboot-survival]].

**hermes VM OOMs building the patched hermes-agent.** hermes has 3.8 GB RAM and 0 swap; vendoring the PR diffs (fetchpatch → local path) changed `patchedHermesSrc`'s hash → full rebuild of hermes-agent + the webpack `hermes-web`/`hermes-tui` → OOM-kills `nixos-rebuild` (`rc=137`; the dry-activate gate aborts before switch). FIX: add a temporary swapfile before redeploy (`fallocate -l 8G /swapfile; chmod 600; mkswap; swapon`), then `swapoff`+`rm`. Long-term: a build host or more hermes RAM (or `zramSwap`/`swapDevices` in nixos). Benign on every hermes switch: `chown/chmod /var/lib/hermes: Operation not permitted` (host-owned virtiofs mount, already correct) — the `hermes-agent-setup` snippet errors but hermes-agent still comes up.
